name: Petrivente (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Petrivente: a blue, red and black shield with a black eagle, a red and white checky, hills and a white swan, above a grey scroll inscribed PETRIVENTE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
